read.what: a worker's probe of the parser on odd paths, a quote among them
read.command:
python -I -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from logsift.parse import parse_line
for t in ['/a\"b', '/a\u2028b', '/a\x0cb', '/a\x85b', '/caf\u00e9', '/a\tb', '/a\x1cb']:
    line='10.0.0.1 - - [12/Oct/2026:09:15:02 +0000] \"GET '+t+' HTTP/1.1\" 200 1 1'
    print(repr(t), parse_line(line) is not None, len(line.splitlines()))
"

import re
def sub(path, old, new):
    s = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
    assert s.count(old) == 1, (path, old)
    open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="").write(s.replace(old, new))
EOF
